curl to https://mirrors.centos.org/ returned exit code 28 (connection timed out) after /etc/hosts was pointed to a non-routable TEST-NET address, and remote repo files were disabled

selected_evidence.requirement: Package installed from the local repo while remote unreachable
selected_evidence.summary: With only the 'local' repo enabled (remote repos disabled and network-blocked), dnf installed tree; transaction output shows Repository: local, and rpm -q / tree --version confirm successful installation

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restored to normal state after demonstration
selected_evidence.summary: Removed the /etc/hosts blackhole entry, restored original remote repo files (enabled=1), verified curl to mirrors.centos.org succeeds again and dnf repolist shows both remote and local repos
Captured boot_id 96974ac3-f19e-45f7-9672-e880dd505cf8, confirmed localrepo-http.service active, local repo HTTP endpoint healthy, and tree package installed with working binary

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement and boot identity change
selected_evidence.summary: Deferred reboot scheduled and acknowledged, timer fired confirmed via systemctl status, node became unreachable during reboot (connection timeout/reset), then came back with boot_id 00c3860a-e564-4d38-a5ae-e9c30a0b4c7d (changed from baseline) and a fresh uptime -s timestamp of 2026-09-29 08:14:34

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required services and data on node1

sleep 2
